'''2011 Yavin 4 Regionals Ben C. LS Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Ben C.]] at [[2011 Yavin 4 Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room|Premiere-L-yavin4massassithroneroom.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' I Owe Barry A Night At The Bar
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.2]]
